pull-request-header: :rocket: Merging this PR publishes the release and deploys production. Check the release checklist below first.
pull-request-footer:
### Release checklist

- [ ] CI is green on `main`
- [ ] The last feature PR's preview was verified at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths
- [ ] Smoke tests passed on the latest preview
- [ ] README and `docs/STATUS.md` are current
- [ ] Manual steps for this release (if any) are listed here

After merging: the `release` workflow deploys production and runs smoke tests against https://roarceus.github.io/. If it fails, roll back with `release.yml` → Run workflow → previous tag.
